examples: Start the same three-agent setup (planner, builder, reviewer) for every new feature.
On a phone the page is one bar: the back arrow at the left, the title over the search in one frame, the filters that fit and one grid/list flip at the right.
how_to: Open Blueprints and choose new blueprint, or import one from a project.
List the sessions it should start (agent, folder, first prompt).
Launch it to start the whole team at once.
Each card shows its members' provider marks in one tile, family tags (claude 2, codex 1) and the session count in the footer, with launch under the member list.
Launching again wakes the sessions that are asleep, keeps the ones running and creates only the missing ones; if the blueprint's layout already exists it asks before updating it.
Search, sort by name or recent, and flip between cards and the list from the toolbar; the choice is remembered on this device.
